note: Independent re-judgment after BGP export-chain next-hop unification (cabc8c511e / c2d7117d05). Verified RFC 8893 Section 1 ('A validating BGP speaker MUST apply Route Origin Validation policy semantics (see Section 2 of [RFC6811] and Section 4 of [RFC8481]) after applying any egress configuration and policy.'), all six cited producers, and all three tagged tests. In cabc8c511e, runPostEgressRPKIValidation and runEgressPolicyChainASN4 gained export-chain NextHopIntent/rawOverride propagation while preserving strict post-egress RPKI validation ordering after non-validating egress policy and final judges; captureOriginatedFacts retained ASOverride/SecondaryAS population alongside precomputeNextHop; live-forward tests in rfc8893_egress_validation_test.go replaced NextHopMode=NextHopUnchanged with BuiltinNextHopUnchanged in the export chain. Q1: verifies bgp-rpki validateOriginForPolicy RFC 6811/8481 semantics and fail-closed inactive behavior, export-chain ordering (remove-private-as before rpki-validation-state even when listed after), live forward with as-override, multi-prefix partial drop, runStaleChain(judgeAll=true), traceLibraryChain, SessionFacts/captureOriginatedFacts, and rejection of routes turned Invalid post-egress or with covered AS_SET. Q2: running RPKI validation before egress policy/config or losing post-policy rewrites fails accept/reject and wire assertions. Q3: BuiltinNextHopUnchanged preserves unchanged next hop without touching AS_PATH or RPKI ordering. Q4: covers live forward, export chain, stale readvertise, dry-run, originated facts, and validator seam.
